title: Night Promo Series
description: A reference-driven Halloween event campaign system that locks nightlife tension, atmospheric darkness, and playful threat across variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a polished Halloween event world built from midnight shadows, ember-orange glow, smoky violet restraint, and theatrical set dressing; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while moving through rooftop party, haunted corridor, and carnival-entry expressions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-midnight-entry-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-rooftop-party-variation, 03-haunted-hotel-variation, 04-carnival-gate-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-midnight-entry-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
